items.title: Shopify Gives Merchants Proof to Fight Agentic Order Chargebacks
items.why: Agentic commerce disputes are emerging; watch how card networks and issuers handle AI-placed orders.
items.summary_ai: Shopify gave merchants more evidence to contest chargebacks on orders placed by AI shopping assistants.
items.take: Agentic commerce disputes are emerging; watch how card networks and issuers handle AI-placed orders.
